notes.title: Allergies and dietary needs
notes.text: Tell us when you book, and please call ahead about serious allergies. Our dishes are built on seasonal ingredients, so some changes are possible and some aren’t; we can’t create separate dishes or custom menus.

notes.title: An extra course
notes.text: Every guest and every evening is a little different. Ask about adding a course or a different combination of dishes.

notes.title: Please note
notes.text: Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs might increase your risk of foodborne illness. Please ask your server if you have any concerns.
